chatbot.title: Lumina Assistant
chatbot.subtitle: Shopping help on the live Platzi catalog
chatbot.welcome: Hi — I can help you search products, browse categories, and explain delivery or payment.
chatbot.replyGreeting: Welcome to Lumina Market. Ask me to find products or explain checkout.
chatbot.replyHelp: I can search the live catalog, point you to categories, and explain shipping, payment, cart, and orders.
chatbot.replyCategories: Browse live collections from Platzi — furniture, shoes, electronics, and more.
chatbot.replyShipping: Standard delivery is free over $200. Express is available at checkout with map-based ETA.
chatbot.replyPayment: Cash on delivery works now. Stripe and PayPal appear only when their keys are configured.
chatbot.replyCart: Your cart is saved on this device after sign-in. I can take you there anytime.
chatbot.replyOrders: Placed orders are stored locally on this device. Open Orders to track them.
chatbot.replySearchPrompt: Tell me what you want — for example “shoes” or “ابحث عن كرسي”.
chatbot.replySearchEmpty: No live matches for “{{query}}”. Try another keyword or open search.
chatbot.replySearchError: I couldn’t reach the catalog for “{{query}}”. Try again in a moment.
chatbot.replyFallback: I didn’t catch that. Try a product name, or ask about shipping, payment, or categories.
chatbot.replyError: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.
